video_title: Timberwolves Summer Check-In: Ayo Dosunmu's Extension, Isaiah Evans' Debut & More

quotes.speaker: James White
quotes.summary_phrase: James White on the Timberwolves' Summer League team chemistry
quotes.excerpt: all the guys that play with each other have a great chemistry, a great feel for each other
quotes.quote: All the guys that play with each other have a great chemistry, a great feel for each other, and I think that's going to serve us well in the Summer League and hopefully beyond.

quotes.speaker: Nathan Bubes
quotes.summary_phrase: Nathan Bubes on the Timberwolves' serious approach to Summer League
quotes.excerpt: we're taking Summer League really seriously with whoever is here
quotes.quote: As an organization, we're taking Summer League really seriously with whoever is here. The record going back to when Pablo went to the championship game in 2019, we're 21 and 11 the last couple years at Summer League, and I'm probably putting a little pressure on myself there.

quotes.speaker: Jaylen Clark
quotes.summary_phrase: Jaylen Clark on his excitement to re-sign with the Timberwolves
quotes.excerpt: can't wait to get back to Mini and get to work this year
quotes.quote: Clark County in Clark County, Minnesota is a great, great place. I'm used to the winners now. I just grown up, I came here as a kid, now 24, going into year three, four. Blessed to be re-signed, can't wait to get back to Mini and get to work this year.

quotes.speaker: Ayo Dosunmu
quotes.summary_phrase: Ayo Dosunmu on why he wanted to stay in Minnesota
quotes.excerpt: I knew once I got traded here that this was home for me
quotes.quote: This is always where I wanted to be at. I knew once I got traded here that this was home for me, and they welcomed me. The fans welcomed me, the coaching staff welcomed me, and my teammates welcomed me. So I always knew that Minnesota was the place I wanted to be at. So it's just a blessing that I'm able to come back and continue my career here because this is where I want to be and I feel like this is where I'm accepted the most.

quotes.speaker: Isaiah Evans
quotes.summary_phrase: Isaiah Evans on his excitement after signing his contract
quotes.excerpt: I've been waiting on this for a minute, so I just feel really blessed right now
quotes.quote: I've been waiting on this for a minute, so I just feel really blessed right now. I'm just trying to learn as much as possible. I just feel like I got a lot to offer but also got a lot to learn, so I'm just trying to take it every day as it's own and just you know trying to grow as fast as I can.

quotes.speaker: Ayo Dosunmu
quotes.summary_phrase: Ayo Dosunmu on his defensive performance and confidence
quotes.excerpt: I just proud of myself on you know sticking my man, being in the right spots
quotes.quote: I mean my defense. I mean the whole week, I just proud of myself on you know sticking my man, being in the right spots and then just trusting that the offense will come later.
